passages.text: When Ben is arrested for Lucy's murder, Phil manipulates Abi into coming forward about Max's fake alibi to the police. Max is arrested and is charged with her murder when Lucy's blood is found on his shoe, from where Jake Stone caused Lucy's nose to bleed on the night she died.
